When we visited after lunch time, it was nice that we could enjoy it to ourselves. The coffee was also very reasonably priced, and since we visited to try a variety of espressos, we asked the owner for a recommendation. Basically, all espresso coffees are based on sweet espresso, so if you don't like sweetness, you can ask for it when ordering and they will remove the raw sugar. We wanted to eat it as is, so we didn't remove the raw sugar... We ordered the basic Espresso (1,8), Vincent (2,8), and Marceau (2,8). Two of us went and ordered three!!
For Vincent, the chewy raw sugar and soft latte in soft milk foam were great to drink as dessert! Basically, the espresso was delicious without being too overpowering, so I was satisfied overall! It was nice to be able to try a dessert-like espresso that didn’t require dessert!

reviews.author: Jeon Sohyun
reviews.text:
During my visit to the cafe, I would like to share that I experienced hygiene incidents and inappropriate response that went beyond simple inconveniences.

First, we noticed a crack in the iced latte glass our group was drinking and reported it to the staff.
However, the employees had conversations holding each other accountable, saying, “Why didn’t I see it?” and “If I had seen it, I would have removed it.”
The customer was exchanged for a new drink by saying, “Shall I give you a refund or a new one,” without a proper apology or explanation, but I was embarrassed to see that even the basics of customer service were not followed.

A more serious problem occurred next.
I had an accident where a piece of glass came out of the iced Lemonicano I was drinking and I chewed it. Under the circumstances, it seemed like the broken part of the latte glass had contained Lemonicano.
Even though I reported this to the store and showed them the crushed glass pieces with my teeth,
The manager concluded that it was more likely to be damaged due to customer carelessness, saying, “You can’t go into the manufacturing process.”

Fortunately, I took a picture of the broken glass as soon as I received it.
Although there was a reasonable possibility that glass damage occurred during manufacturing (ice added, contact with metal scoop, glasses colliding in a narrow space, etc.),
The response that ignored this and placed the responsibility on the customer without any clear basis or evidence was extremely inappropriate.
In addition, there was no CCTV installed to film the manufacturing process, so there was no way to verify the authenticity.

The person who appeared to be the representative remained silent without any intervention even though he was watching the entire situation from the table next to him.
Only later did they try to absolve themselves of responsibility by mentioning insurance processing and saying, “The process after that has nothing to do with us.”

This cafe lacked basic hygiene management, crisis response, and customer service.
Rather than acknowledging the problem, they consistently avoided responsibility.

The cafe's sanitary conditions and response system clearly need improvement.
I think that cafe operators also need to take responsibility and respond seriously to these issues.

I found this quiet place on Naver while having dinner near Seongsu-dong, and I really liked the photos. I wasn't disappointed when I went, and was pleasantly surprised in many ways.

It has a simple yet cozy atmosphere that matches the speakeasy atmosphere, making it a great place for locals to come in groups or even alone to relax after work. There's no menu, but the bartender will make recommendations if you ask a few questions, and it's a great place to discover new drinks and combinations. Cocktail and whiskey bar in Seongsu-dong. The biggest feature is that there is no separate menu. I've been to cocktail bars that don't have menus a few times before, but this is the first time I've seen a place where you can customize your drinks in such detail.

I requested a whiskey-based cocktail with high alcohol content, sweetness, and smokiness, while my companion requested a cocktail with some alcohol content, dryness, and without a strong herbal scent. Then, the bartender brought a variety of drinks and let us smell them, adjusting the level of sweetness, fruit flavor, and herbal flavor.

So the resulting cocktail was
♤ 100 Year Old Cigar
♤ Topsy-turvy
It's like this.

The Baeknyeon Cigar I received was a whiskey and rum base, so it had a high alcohol content and sweetness, and as its name suggests, it had a spicy, smoky flavor and was a unique cocktail with an absinthe herbal scent. I was satisfied as it matched most of my requests.

The Topsy-turvy the group received contains whiskey, vermouth, and coffee liqueur, so it has a subtle coffee scent and a bit of sweetness. A Manhattan cocktail that replaces bitters with coffee liqueur. The bartender asked if I could make it as sweet as Pocari Sweat, but it was just that sweet and not overwhelming. I felt like Deokup was truly passionate about cocktails through this level of meticulous customization.

Although you may feel cumbersome during the ordering process, we recommend this place because it is a place where you can get results that meet your expectations.
